capabilities: Navigate notes in a two-pane notebooks/sections/pages popup or sidebar
Search notes as-you-type with IME support and notebook-scoped or global scope
Reorder notebooks, sections, and pages via physics drag-and-drop
Create, rename, and delete notes with folder-note sub-page hierarchy and safe deletion
Export, import, and reset custom ordering as a .json file
disambiguation: Not a OneNote import or sync tool; it brings OneNote-style navigation to Obsidian notes inside the vault.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Navigation relies on a configurable root folder (default "OneNote") where folders act as notebooks and sub-folders as sections.
intentEvidence: a local alternative to Microsoft OneNote, Evernote, UpNote, Bear, or Joplin
problem: Obsidian's file-based navigation lacks a notebooks/sections/pages hierarchy and a fast popup switcher for users used to OneNote-style note organization.

relations.evidence: inspired by Microsoft OneNote and Fluent Design principles

summary: Two-pane navigation plugin that organizes notes as OneNote-style notebooks, sections, and pages with a floating popup, search, and drag-and-drop.
